ticks.note: Tick 1 enters the initial state, `Off`, and `level` starts at 0.
A press. The transition out of `Off` fires: `level` becomes 30 and the lamp is `Dim`.
Released. `Dim` has nothing to do, so the lamp stays at 30.
A third press goes from `Bright` back to `Off` and sets `level` to 0.
Released. The lamp waits in `Off` for the next press.
